name: orbit-gallery
title: Orbit Gallery
description: WebGL gallery of image tiles laid out on concentric rings that orbit a shared centre at different speeds.

meta.interaction: The rings turn on their own; scrolling shoves them faster before they coast back to their normal pace. Hovering a tile dims it, clicking floats it to the centre as a large panel while the rings shrink back, and clicking the empty space or pressing Escape smears it away again.

props.name: mode
props.description:
- texture: children render into an FBO each frame: Global post-processing will work on it.
- scissor: a scissored pass painted on top of the composed frame. lighter, but excluded from global post-processing.
